adopted.evidence: The weak flat-topped native bump in order 54 has only a faint, poorly separated central excess against strong continuum/background-gradient residuals. The fixed central enlargement does not reveal a sufficiently clear isolated charge pixel, track, or secure photon profile; retain ambiguous morphology.
adopted.root_adoption_note: Separate reviews agree; provisionally adopted after root evidence checks.

primary.evidence: The weak flat-topped native bump in order 54 has only a faint, poorly separated central excess against strong continuum/background-gradient residuals. The fixed central enlargement does not reveal a sufficiently clear isolated charge pixel, track, or secure photon profile; retain ambiguous morphology.

secondary.evidence: o54 has a small flat-topped two-sample native feature. The fixed central enlargement is dominated by curved trace/background residuals; the weak near-center excess is not resolved as an unambiguous isolated charge deposit or a secure photon-shaped line. Retain unresolved.

historical_review_note: The singleton0271 original U/U/U chain and own four true mapping stages remain. The own secondary review retains additional uncertainty without a recorded blend caution. Own March30 discovery and six reused HD128582 observations; restoration decodes headers only.
